title: Enable Gantt direct launch and rendered release signal
observed_behavior: File Settings originally did not expose `Gantt Chart` in the `View to Launch` selector, and the first direct-launch attempt also left the Processing Files dialog open because Gantt never marked itself as the rendered launch view.
intended_behavior: `Gantt Chart` should be available in File Settings so uploaded data can launch directly into the Gantt view just like the other supported view targets.
cause_summary: The File Settings `#default-view` select was missing a `Gantt Chart` option, and the Gantt component did not participate in the shared network-rendered completion hook that releases the Processing Files dialog for non-2D direct launches.
fix_summary: Added `Gantt Chart` to File Settings and marked Gantt as rendered on direct launch so the shared processing modal clears once the view is interactive.
notes: Closed after the maintained direct-launch Gantt smoke passed on both uploaded node+link and sequence-node fixtures.

title: Auto-close Gantt export dialog after image save
observed_behavior: Clicking `Save Image` exported the Gantt artifact successfully, but the `Export Gantt Chart` dialog originally stayed open until the user closed it manually.
intended_behavior: The export dialog should dismiss automatically after a successful save, matching the other maintained export flows.
cause_summary: `GanttComponent.saveImage()` saved the requested artifact but never closed the export pane or updated `ShowGanttExportPane` after save.
fix_summary: Close the Gantt export dialog after the save completes so the export flow returns to the rendered chart automatically.
notes: Closed after `saveImage()` and the dialog `onHide` path were wired to reset the export-pane state and the maintained SVG/PNG/JPEG export journey passed without manual dialog cleanup.

title: Handle Gantt empty initial data without runtime errors
observed_behavior: Opening Gantt with no entries and then reopening `Gantt Settings` after entry creation could surface the global runtime-error banner and block existing-entry edits, visual settings, and fallback-name checks.
intended_behavior: Gantt should tolerate an empty initial data state and keep `Gantt Settings` interactive before and after entry creation without raising a runtime error.
cause_summary: `GanttChartService.setValues()` reduced empty `froms` and `tos` arrays during the initial empty-entry render, which raised a client-side exception before the first real entry existed and left the runtime banner active for later settings flows.
fix_summary: Guard the empty-timeline initialization path so the chart service can render a blank Gantt state without reducing empty arrays or tripping the global runtime banner.
notes: Closed after the empty-data guard landed in `GanttChartService`, the Cypress settings helper no longer needed the runtime-banner dismiss workaround, and the maintained controls, multi-entry, and export journeys all passed cleanly.

title: Sync Gantt settings row color after updates
observed_behavior: Changing an existing Gantt entry color updated the rendered bars and legend swatch, but the settings-table row stayed at the original color, so the table and chart drifted out of sync.
intended_behavior: Changing an existing Gantt entry color should keep the settings-table row, rendered chart, and legend swatch synchronized.
cause_summary: `GanttComponent.updateEntryColor()` updated `ganttChartData` but never wrote the new color back to `ganttEntries`, so the settings table kept stale row state.
fix_summary: Update `ganttEntries` inside `updateEntryColor()` and trigger change detection so the settings table row color stays synchronized with the rendered chart and legend.
notes: Closed after the maintained Gantt controls journey verified existing-entry color sync end-to-end.

title: Ignore incomplete dates when building Gantt timelines
observed_behavior: Creating a Gantt entry from the synthetic sparse-date fields originally rendered all four uploaded nodes, including rows where the start date or end date was blank, because blank date cells had already been globally backfilled before Gantt built its timelines.
intended_behavior: Rows missing either the start date or the end date should be excluded from the Gantt chart so only complete timelines render.
cause_summary: The shared finish-up pipeline backfilled blank `*date*` fields in-place, so Gantt could no longer distinguish original blanks from legitimate dates when it built entry timelines.
fix_summary: Preserved the original date-field values before backfilling and had Gantt build entry timelines from those raw values so blank start/end rows are skipped correctly.
notes: Closed after the maintained edge-case Gantt journey verified sparse-row filtering and timezone normalization together.

title: Require start field before creating Gantt entries
observed_behavior: The initial `Gantt Settings` dialog allowed `Create Entry` while both date selectors were still `None`, which could create an empty entry row with no timelines.
intended_behavior: `Create Entry` should stay blocked until a valid start date field is selected so the empty default dialog state cannot create blank Gantt entries.
cause_summary: `GanttComponent.createGanttEntry()` had no guard for the default empty field selection, and the template exposed an always-enabled submit button even when `GanttStartVariable` was blank.
fix_summary: Require a start date before allowing Gantt entry creation and disable the submit button until the dialog has a valid start-field selection.
notes: Closed after the maintained empty-state Gantt journey verified the disabled default button state and a valid entry could still be created immediately after selecting a date field.
